title.orig: An Act Strengthening and Institutionalizing Direct Credit Support of the Land Bank of the Philippines to Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries, Small Farmers and Fisherfolk, Further Amending Republic Act No. 3844, Otherwise Known as the “Agricultural Land Reform Code”, as Amended

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10878_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 75 of Republic Act No. 3844, as amended, is hereby further amended by adding a new subsection (15) to read as follows:
"(15) To offer and issue common and preferred shares of stocks to ARBs, small farmers and fisherfolk through their organizations, cooperatives, federations and cooperative banks; development partners and strategic investors such as multilateral and bilateral institutions; rural banks and their associations, in quantities to be determined by the Board of Directors and in accordance with applicable laws, rules and regulations: Provided, However, That the National Government shall maintain, at all times, at least two-thirds (2⁄3) ownership of the total outstanding common shares of the Bank.
"Preferred shares of stock shall be non-voting. Other features of preferred shares shall be determined by the Board of Directors in accordance with applicable laws and regulations."

Implementing Rules and Regulations. - The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, in consultation with the Land Bank of the Philippines, shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary for the implementation of this Act.
Repealing Clause. - All laws, executive orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with any provision hereof are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Separability Clause. - If any provision or part hereof is held invalid, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain and continue to be in full force and effect.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
